methods.name: create
methods.summary: Uploads a new OpenAPI schema for API Shield schema validation.
methods.description:
Uploads a new OpenAPI schema for API Shield schema validation. The schema
defines expected request/response formats for API endpoints.

props.name: name
props.description: A human-readable name for the schema

props.name: source
props.description: The raw schema, e.g., the OpenAPI schema, either as JSON or YAML

props.name: validation_enabled
props.description: An indicator if this schema is enabled

methods.name: list
methods.summary: Lists all OpenAPI schemas uploaded to API Shield with pagination support.
methods.description: Lists all OpenAPI schemas uploaded to API Shield with pagination support.

props.name: omit_source
props.description: Omit the source-files of schemas and only retrieve their meta-data.

methods.name: delete
methods.summary: Permanently removes an uploaded OpenAPI schema from API Shield.
methods.description:
Permanently removes an uploaded OpenAPI schema from API Shield. Operations using
this schema will lose their validation rules.

methods.name: edit
methods.summary: Modifies an existing OpenAPI schema in API Shield, updating the validation rules for associated API operations.
methods.description:
Modifies an existing OpenAPI schema in API Shield, updating the validation rules
for associated API operations.

props.name: validation_enabled
props.description: Flag whether schema is enabled for validation.

methods.description:

methods.name: update
methods.summary: Fully updates schema validation settings for a specific API operation.
methods.description: Fully updates schema validation settings for a specific API operation.

props.name: mitigation_action
props.description:
When set, this applies a mitigation action to this operation

- `"log"` - log request when request does not conform to schema for this
  operation
- `"block"` - deny access to the site when request does not conform to schema
  for this operation
- `"none"` - will skip mitigation for this operation
- `null` - clears any mitigation action

methods.description:

methods.summary: Updates schema validation settings for multiple API operations in a single request.
methods.description:
Updates schema validation settings for multiple API operations in a single
request. Efficient for applying consistent validation rules across endpoints.

methods.summary: Fully updates global schema validation settings for a zone, replacing existing configuration.
methods.description:
Fully updates global schema validation settings for a zone, replacing existing
configuration.

props.name: validation_default_mitigation_action
props.description:
The default mitigation action used Mitigation actions are as
follows:

- `"log"` - log request when request does not conform to schema
- `"block"` - deny access to the site when request does not conform to schema
- `"none"` - skip running schema validation

props.name: validation_override_mitigation_action
props.description:
When set, this overrides both zone level and operation level
mitigation actions.

- `"none"` - skip running schema validation entirely for the request
- `null` - clears any existing override
